target_project: Shire Journey UE4.27.2 private offline experience
rules: Commercial-license uncertainty does not by itself block PRIVATE_OFFLINE_ONLY local experimentation.
Do not promote any private-only asset into the DISTRIBUTABLE_FRAMEWORK lane without separate rights clearance.
Animated production assets accepted by the project end as FBX; production textures use PNG/TGA.
Heavy runtime assets remain soft-referenced and asynchronously loaded when integrated.
Do not claim READY/INTEGRATED/ACCEPTED states without the evidence required by the project Governor.
